summary: Two hikers found human remains (a partial skull and other bone fragments) near Spruce Trail by the water tower in Manitou Springs and brought them to the police; EPCSAR searched the area the next day with two cadaver dog teams; coroner autopsy found surgical hardware from an orthopedic repair, identity and cause of death undetermined at publication
location: Spruce Trail (near the water tower), Manitou Springs
responding_agency: El Paso County SAR + El Paso County Sheriff's Office + Manitou Springs Police Department
notes: Year verified 2022 (KOOL 1079 cites the EPCSO press release dated May 29, 2022); EPCSAR field search was 2022-05-30, autopsy 2022-05-31; remains discovery date used per convention; no victim name released
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (El Paso County, Colorado, United States)
